# Lawrence Energy Services Limited (LESL)

> Turnkey electrical and mechanical engineering contractors in Nigeria since 2009. Over 400 MW installed capacity, 100,000 accident-free man-hours, and trusted alliances with Cummins West Africa, Clarke Energy Ltd, and 7up Bottling Company.

## Core Capabilities
- Power Generation: Turnkey multi-megawatt gas generator power plant installation and commissioning (Jenbacher, Caterpillar, Cummins).
- Substations & Switchgear: 11 kV / 33 kV substation erection, switchgear assembly, RMU maintenance, transformer installation, and protection testing.
- Mechanical & Industrial Piping: High-pressure gas pipelines, steam piping (ASME B31.3), boiler burners, fuel gas conditioning skids, and acoustic soundproofing down to 69 dB.
- Technical Consultancy, Testing & Commissioning: Secondary injection, dielectric testing, heat rate audits, and power quality analysis.

## Key Projects
- Mamuda Group 30 MW Greenfield Power Station, Challawa, Kano.
- Seven-Up Bottling Company (SBC) Ikeja IPP (17.6 MW Gas Generation).
- Seven-Up Bottling Company (SBC) Kano Gas Burner & Boiler Piping.
- Elebele 9 MW Gas Turbine IPP, Bayelsa State.
- Lagos Free Zone (LFZ) 100,000 Safe Man-Hours Safety Recognition Award, Ibeju Lekki, Lagos.
